hook: What distinguishes military occupation from later administration?

claims.text: Manhyia describes Asantehene and allegiance oaths. NAM describes Kumasi’s 1896 occupation and forced protection. Accra’s municipal account dates its council to 1898. Ghana’s judiciary describes separate Ashanti administration commencing 1902 under the Gold Coast Governor. Occupation, council establishment and incorporation differ; neither non-resistance nor institutional labels establish consent.

One council established in both cities in 1896.
